Native guarded Python PTY query/reply and owned shm read/unlink, literal positive/negative consumer controls, independently decoded PNG/PPM assets, Python Unicode and separate canvas math validate expectations in setup. No GNU GPU API, GLES, shader, DMABUF or physical rendering equivalence is claimed.
cases.comparison: Exact result.json pixels/cursor/geometry/input-variable bytes and canvas.rgba versus independently authored fixture data rechecked by guest reference math. Full untouched PTY wire, per-packet payloads and intermediate composition pixels, actual helper replies/suppression, owned shm inode/data/unlink observations, geometry, syscall readiness, modes before/during/after input, elapsed intervals and original shell output stay in diagnostics. No sent key or FAIL implies an unexecuted later phase.

cases.purpose: Actual Kitty APC is consumed through an owned PTY: static-cursor; strict RGB24 payload and grammar, q2 quiet acceptance, exact1:1 cell/pixel placement and protocol cursor movement.

files.scenario.json:
{
  "kind": "kitty",
  "description": "Actual Kitty APC is consumed through an owned PTY: static-cursor; strict RGB24 payload and grammar, q2 quiet acceptance, exact1:1 cell/pixel placement and protocol cursor movement.",
  "geometry": [
    20,
    40,
    80,
    80
  ],
  "initial_cursor": [
    2,
    3
  ],
  "placement_cells": [
    4,
    8
  ],
  "static_cursor": true,
  "tmux": false,
  "options": [
    "--raw-apc",
    "--no-tmux",
    "-w",
    "8",
    "-H",
    "4",
    "--id",
    "42",
    "--placement",
    "7",
    "--z-index",
    "-1",
    "--static-cursor"
  ],
  "nonfinal_chunks": 0,
  "peer": {},
  "expected_result": {
    "image_rgba_base64": "",
    "placement_cells": [
      4,
      8
    ],
    "cursor": [
      2,
      3
    ],
    "responses_sent": 0
  }
}
